title: Base64 byte codecs, a Redis EVAL call and the bundler global shim run no decoded code
intent: Synthetic regression for a storage adapter and a bundled extension. Buffer/atob base64 decoding into typed arrays, a Redis client's `client.eval(luaScript)` and webpack's `new Function('return this')()` global resolution are not dynamic code execution, so added files using them must not raise code.dynamic-evaluation. The encode on one line and the decode several lines later must not be joined into one match. All samples are inert FileRecord strings.
